clauses.reason: The operative paragraph of Executive Order 8401 exempts Percy Nicholls from compulsory retirement for age under section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, for a term it states as 'for a period of one year ending June 30, 1941'. The exemption is a fixed-term command, so it ends by its own terms on the stated date, 1941-06-30. The date is recorded inclusive, as the exemption runs through the end of June 30, 1941; the exclusive reading, under which the term ends when that day begins, is the alternative. The grant is personal to one named person and nothing in the held text makes it depend on a report, an event or a later order. A later order, Executive Order 8778 dated June 11, 1941, recites this order and grants a further exemption 'for a period of one year ending June 30, 1942'. It is recorded as a later event with its own date. It is a separate command and does not end this order's term, which is the stated term of this order alone.
